verdict.rationale: The only first-party pointer is a GitHub item at github.com/keycloak/keycloak, and its excerpt describes a Node.js adapter rather than the core server source. The open-license element rests only on a community remark that indirectly calls Keycloak a FOSS project. The reviewer's concern is valid: the evidence does not establish readable core source or license terms, so full credit is unsupported. missing for 10: explicit license name/terms (e.g., an OSI-approved license statement), confirmation that the core server source is publicly readable, first-party docs on source availability, independent corroboration.
